answer_1.quote: We use an encoder-decoder style T5-large model for all our experiments. The baseline models in our experiments are fine-tuned T5 models for the corresponding tasks using the MLE objective.
answer_1.outputs: The model takes a concatenated context and question as an input to produce an answer output.

answer_2.quote: In addition to standard metrics on these datasets, we additionally evaluate using consistency. This metric evaluates to true only if all the questions in a bundle are answered correctly, and is thus a stricter version of EM.
